notes.title: [Ver1.2.0] The AI has become even smarter!
notes.content:
[p]The AI has become even smarter and can now learn player actions more easily.
Here are the update details:
[/p][p][b]AI Update:[/b] Improved understanding of actions for smoother learning
[b]Optimization & Speed:[/b] New save format makes record and analysis screens faster and lighter
[b]Overall Improvements:[/b] Enhanced game flow and various bug fixes[/p][p][b]Note:[/b]After updating, a one-time upgrade of your learning data will be required at the first launch. Please follow the on-screen instructions.
[/p][p]Enjoy the evolved BlockWorld Ai![/p]
